content: “Uct x yinni dd-ihwan ɣar Miṣra ḥima ad afen twiza, inni ittecřen x yeysan u tteggen řaman deg ikarruten, minzi nitni deg waṭṭas, uřa x yinni inyin x yeysan, minzi nitni jjehden, axmi war xezzaren ɣar Umqeddas n Israil u war arezzun SIDI.”
“Maca uřa d Netta d amiɣis, Netta ggur ad yejj řɣar ad dd-yas. War ittdikkwiř deg wawař nnes, ad ikkar ḍidd i taddart n iɛeffanen u ḍidd i twiza n yinni itteggen řmuɛṣiyyet.

Maɣar Imiṣriyyen d iwdan, war ǧin d Arebbi, uca iysan nsen d aysum, war iǧi d arruḥ. Ad isarreḥ SIDI afus nnes ař i ɣa inqarḍ wenni iwcin afus, uca xenni ad iwḍa uřa d wenni dayes iwcin afus. Ammu i ɣa qḍan nitni marra idsen.”

“Maɣar ammu i d ayi inna SIDI: ‘Am mammec ittarrujdud wayrad niɣ wayrad ameẓyan x zzardet nnes xmi xas dd-ttřaɣan ijj n ubarru n imeksawen, břa ma ad innexřeɛ zi tmijja nsen u war ixennes zeg ubarru nsen, ammu i ɣa ihwa uřa d SIDI n řɛeskarat ḥima ad immneɣ x wedrar n Ṣihyun u x tewrirt nnes.
Am yijḍaḍ ittfarfiren sennej i řɛucc nsen, ammu i ɣa isseřqa SIDI n řɛeskarat x Urcalim. Ad tt issar, ad tt issenjem, ad xas yekk uca ad tt issenjem.”
“Dewřem-dd ɣar wenni x ḥeyyden ayt n Israil s waṭṭas.
Maɣar deg wass nni ad immenḍar kuř ijj l’aṣnam nnes n nnuqart d l’aṣnam nnes n wureɣ, inni yeggin ifassen nwem i yixef nwem, i ddenb.
Accur ad iwḍa s ssif, war iǧi ssif n ijj n weryaz. Ad t yecc ssif, war iǧi n ijj n bnadem. Ad yarweř Accur zzat i ssif uca iḥudriyyen nnes ad dewřen ɣar tesmuɣi.
Taṣḍart nnes ad teggʷej s tiggʷudi uca řḥukkam nnes ad arewřen zi tɛeǧant!’, ammu i iqqar SIDI, wenni ɣar teǧa tmessi di Ṣihyun uřa d tafqunt di Urcalim.”
